This file is GITIGNORED in a real project because it holds secrets.
Run /project-setup instead of editing this by hand — it asks only the questions your
project actually needs, verifies each MCP with a real call, and writes this file for you.
context7 + framelink-figma MCP servers ship WITH the plugin (bundled in plugin.json) — do NOT
redefine them here. This file only holds the Figma token (env), OAuth-connector notes, and tlm.
//mcpServers: context7 and framelink-figma are bundled by the plugin and load automatically — nothing to add.
The bundled Framelink server reads FIGMA_ACCESS_TOKEN from the env block below.
Add an mcpServers block here ONLY for a project-specific server the plugin does not bundle.
//mcpConnectors: ClickUp and Slack are OAuth connectors, not stdio servers — they do NOT appear above.
Connect them at claude.ai → Settings → Connectors, then verify with /mcp in Claude Code.
Linear:  claude mcp add --transport sse linear https://mcp.linear.app/sse
GitHub Issues: no MCP — just `gh auth login`.

env.//: SECRETS. Never commit. Never echo back to the user.

//pluginRepo: OPTIONAL. Enable only for a team member who maintains the house rules and wants to change them
from this project and open PRs back to the plugin. /project-setup vendors the plugin into
.claude/tlm-plugin/ and rule-capture opens PRs via skills/rule-capture/plugin-pr.sh. Leave
enabled:false (or omit) in a plain consuming project. See tlm-config.reference.json → tlm.pluginRepo.
